## Scope

The only product change is `tests/openspec-cli-compatibility.mjs`, plus this change's own planning/evidence artifacts. The probe verifies the pinned OpenSpec 1.16.0 Claude core skill/command inventory, rejects omitted optional-workflow references, and exercises scratch environment isolation and cleanup controls. No package, prerequisite, installation-policy, runtime, or capability-spec change.

## Verification and independent review

Retained candidate gates passed: `npm run test:openspec`, `npm test` (259 tests), `npm run build`, `npm run validate:openspec`, strict native OpenSpec validation, and the full candidate-range whitespace check. Those are historical exact-candidate executions, not this PR's required CI or post-merge target gates. A fresh read-only candidate check confirmed the same SHA/tree, approved digest and all six tasks complete.

A fresh independent Claude Code review used `claude-opus-5-5`, session `5b341b3a-2b0b-424d-bffd-6a5a9561262e`, with read-only tools. It reported PASS for product correctness, no blocking findings, one low non-blocking diagnostic finding, and two scope/limitation notes. It read all 48 retained evidence pages, source and approved plan. The operator explicitly approved this review-route exception and accepted the low diagnostic limitation for this delivery.

L1, retained rather than hidden: if probe execution and log writing both fail, the log-write exception can mask the original failure. Cleanup still executes. Error masking also existed before this change. The operator chose to accept this non-blocking limitation without changing the frozen candidate. Reference-matching boundaries and the npm-child environment boundary remain documented scope limits, not sandbox guarantees.

The old F1 claim about hyphen-suffixed short references was independently refuted by tracing the actual exact-or-hyphen-prefix predicate and its passing `assert.throws` controls. The old rejected review and its provenance limitations remain rejected/unproved; this new review does not rewrite them.

Full factual evidence will be retained with the authorized closure record, not fabricated as a prospective merge result.

## Integration boundary

Require the active strict `verify` check from GitHub Actions on this exact up-to-date head and resolved review threads. Use merge-commit integration to preserve reviewed-candidate ancestry; no squash/rebase, direct main push, force or protection bypass.
